sentence_1_it: Appena i tre medici avevano lasciato la stanza, la Fata andò al letto di Pinocchio e, toccandolo sulla fronte, notò che stava bruciando di febbre.
sentence_1_en: As soon as the three doctors had left the room, the Fairy went to Pinocchio's bed and, touching him on the forehead, noticed that he was burning with fever.
